newsitem.title: USA: GeoTel gets $7.8 mln order for BT network.
newsitem.headline: GeoTel gets $7.8 mln order for BT network.

text.p: GeoTel Communications Corp said on Wednesday it received a $7.8 million order from Digital Equipment Co Ltd to supply British Telecommunications with its new network intelligent callrouter, or Network ICR, solution.

Digital has contracted GeoTel to provide BT with GeoTel's ICR software and product support while Digital will supply server platforms, networking solutions and all integration services, the company said.
Further details of the agreement were not disclosed.
The company said BT will be able to offer intelligent call distribution services to multiple customers from the same processing platform with the ICR Network.

The network's base configuration, which accommodates 200 call centers receiving up to 100 calls per second, can be expanded to handle more than 1,600 call centers and 600 calls per second, the company said.
